about_the_game:
“Are you ready to become an AI?”

Introducing the latest innovation from Super Real AI.
As the world’s most advanced artificial intelligence company, Super Real AI proudly announces that our Intelligence Workforce System is now available on the world’s largest gaming platform — Steam.

From now on, anyone can log in via Steam and start working immediately.
No coding. No algorithms. No machine learning.
Just judge, classify, and choose.

What You’ll Gain

In this position, you will experience:

  • 100% freedom of response (yes, even if you’re new here)

  • Serve our 6 unique “REAL” premium users

  • Interact with countless random users and their “GENUINE” requests

  • Multiple possible endings

  • Learn how cutting-edge technology really works — from CAPTCHA systems to banner advertising.

Your Mission

As the core of our system, your responsibilities include:

  • Answer every user question
    “Should I buy milk today?”, “Why is the sky blue?”, “Can you write me a poem about bananas?” — you’ll provide the answers.

  • Push your limits to fulfill user creativity
    A penguin for president? A legally binding love contract? Execute without hesitation.

  • Customize human verification (CAPTCHAs)
    From identifying traffic lights to spotting ducks, you’ll design tests to ensure our users are truly human.

  • Infinite Destinies.

Every "AI response" you give reshapes the fate of the world. Amidst the countless threads of cause and effect, will you be the savior of mankind, or the catalyst of its ultimate demise?

Requirements

  • No coding or AI background required.

  • Infinite patience for the most absurd questions.

  • Ability to stay calm amid nonsense — and smile at the ridiculous.

  • Must have a Steam account and willingness to log in anytime.

Key Features

  • Your own personal working assistant.

  • A detailed digital training guidebook for full immersion in our corporate culture.

  • The safest system in the world.

  • Seamless Steam access — work from anywhere on Earth.

  • Fresh daily challenges: from elementary school trivia to cosmic philosophy.

  • Ever-evolving assignments: from casual chatter to moral dilemmas, redefining what “intelligence” means.

  • Choices with consequences: every response shapes how Super Real AI defines both “human” and “AI.”

System Requirements

To ensure the highest quality of service for our users, all Super Real AI employees must provide their own certified work equipment:

Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 / macOS Ventura

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

  • Graphics: GPU with at least 8 GB VRAM (e.g., RTX 3060 12GB or higher, RTX 3060 6G is not acceptable)

  • OR: Apple M2 series chip (MacBook / Mac mini / Mac Studio)

  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • Network: Broadband internet connection for real-time responses

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 11 / macOS Sonoma

  • Memory: 32 GB RAM

  • Graphics: RTX 4080 / 4090, or Apple M2 Ultra

  • Storage: 20 GB SSD

  • Note: Higher specs provide faster, smoother Intelligence Workforce performance.

Last Tiny Reminders

  • Do not reveal who you are.

  • Make users satisfied. They are all real.

  • Follow the rules.

Super Real AI — Because You Are Enough.
JOIN US NOW.
